'''Kosuge Jinja''' (小菅神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=shrine|1=Shinto shrine}}.

* {{ill|Kosuge Shrine (Katsushika)|ja|小菅神社 (葛飾区)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kosuge Shrine (Katsushika)}} - {{ill|Tokyo|en|Tokyo|qid=Q1490|lt=Tokyo|1=Tokyo}}{{ill|Katsushika|en|Katsushika|qid=Q232628|lt=Katsushika Ward|1=Katsushika}} enshrined
* {{ill|Kosuge Shrine (Iiyama)|ja|小菅神社 (飯山市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kosuge Shrine (Iiyama)}} - {{ill|Nagano Prefecture|en|Nagano Prefecture|qid=Q127877|lt=Nagano Prefecture|1=Nagano Prefecture}}{{ill|Iiyama, Nagano|en|Iiyama, Nagano|qid=Q851097|lt=Iiyama|1=Iiyama, Nagano}} enshrined. It was known as {{ill|Kosugeyama|ja|小菅山|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kosugeyama|1=Q11463528|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11463528}} and, along with {{ill|Mount Togakushi|en|Mount Togakushi|qid=Q11496659|lt=Mount Togakushi|1=Mount Togakushi}} and {{ill|Mount Iizuna|en|Mount Iizuna|qid=Q11666652|lt=Mount Iinawa|1=Mount Iizuna}}, was one of the three major Shugendō sacred sites in Shinshu.
